# Release checklist

- [ ] All quality gates for the track pass (`/verify`)
- [ ] Environment variables set in the host (names match `.env.example`)
- [ ] Database migrations applied and reversible
- [ ] Error monitoring and logging on
- [ ] Backups configured
- [ ] Custom domain and HTTPS working
- [ ] A rollback step is written down and understood
- [ ] Owner has approved the go-live
